entities.name: UbiE C-methyltransferase
observations: Sequence is 258 aa and matches reviewed UbiE homologs at ~55% identity and ~93% query coverage.
Homolog annotations assign SAM-dependent C-methylation in menaquinone and ubiquinone biosynthesis; exact substrate specificity for query remains inferred.

entities.name: UbiE quinol methylation
observations: Homolog-reported reaction: demethylmenaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → menaquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.
Homologs also methylate a polyprenyl methoxybenzenediol precursor in ubiquinone biosynthesis.
